app.tagline: Several AIs debate your project before you build it.
app.footer: Open source under AGPL v3. Model answers can be wrong: check the claims marked estimated or assumed.

nav.noSessions: No session yet. Start one to see it here.

home.ideaPlaceholder: e.g. A booking app for our 12 yoga studios, with passes and reminders
home.demoHint: A recorded debate in English. No API key needed.
home.noKey: No API key is configured on this server, so only the demo is available.
home.newLead: Describe the project you want to prepare. Quorumind interviews you, then the models debate and an arbiter rules.

review.title: Check your requirements
review.lead: The debate relies only on this sheet. Correct anything wrong. Hard constraints make an option infeasible.
review.currencyHint: ISO code, such as EUR or USD.
review.currencyInvalid: Enter the budget's currency as an ISO code, such as EUR.
review.currencyNote: Every amount of this debate will be in {{currency}}.
review.complianceHint: Each box checked is a hard constraint for every option.

compliance.gdpr: Personal data of people in the EU (GDPR)

profile.title: Your organisation profile
profile.lead: Proposals will stay within your profile:
profile.rates: work packages priced with your {{count}} day rate(s) in {{currency}}
profile.saved: Profile as saved on {{date}}. Later changes will not affect this debate.
profile.ignore: Ignore the profile for this debate
profile.ignoreHint: The proposals then follow the requirements alone, priced with day rates the proposers estimate.

debate.questionsLead: Your answers decide between the options. The debate resumes as soon as you reply.

verdict.none: No option is feasible as it stands.
verdict.shortened: The debate was shortened to stay within its budget: {{done}} of the {{planned}} planned round(s) took place before the verdict.

cost.label: Cost so far
cost.partial: Some model prices are unknown: the total is partial.

error.title: The session stopped
error.request: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.

common.copyFailed: Could not copy: the link is selected, copy it with your keyboard.

costs.included: Included in the debate price. The table lists each model call and its tokens.

modeHint.standard: The models design competing options, criticise each other and the arbiter rules.
modeHint.express: Five questions, one short round: a fast first opinion on an idea.
modeHint.challenge: Bring your own solution: the models only hunt for its flaws before you commit.
modeHint.audit: A quote or a proposal from a provider: the models check it against your need and tell you what to ask.

setup.solutionPlaceholder: Describe what you plan to build and how: stack, hosting, team, timeline…
setup.devilHint: The devil's advocate proposes nothing: it attacks every option to surface hidden costs and risks.
setup.redactHint: E-mails, phone numbers, card numbers, IBANs and keys are replaced before anything is sent to the models.
setup.notify: E-mail me when the debate ends or needs my answer
setup.estimateUnknown: The cost estimate is unavailable for some of these models; the real cost is shown as the debate runs.
setup.importing: Wait for the documents to finish importing before you start.

audit.explain: Attach the document you received from a provider: a quote, a statement of work, an architecture or a technical proposal. Say in a few lines what it is for: the interview only asks what the document does not tell. You get an opinion, the findings with the passages they are about, the price checked, and a list of questions to send the provider.
audit.documentsLead: PDF, Word, text or a web page. You can attach your own documents too, such as your specification: untick “Under audit” for those.
audit.noneAudited: Tick “Under audit” for at least one document.
audit.needPlaceholder: e.g. A booking website for our 12 yoga studios, to launch before September with a budget of €20,000
audit.alternativeHint: A model designs its own approach from your need alone, without reading the document: an independent order of magnitude. It costs one more call.

setup.researchHint: Before the proposals, short generic queries (never your documents or personal data) look up current prices, versions, end-of-life dates and rules. The report cites its sources.
setup.researchEuropean: Off with European models only: no search engine keeps the queries in Europe.

compliance.label: Compliance
compliance.hint: Adds the rules of these frameworks to the interview, and the arbiter checks each option against them. You can combine them with a project type. This is not legal advice.

european.label: European models only
european.hint: Every role is played by a model of a European provider served from the EU (Mistral AI), or by a model run on this server (Ollama).
european.gatewayEu: Requests to OpenRouter go through its EU region: questions and answers are processed in Europe.
european.gatewayGlobal: Requests to OpenRouter go through its global servers, which may be outside the EU, before reaching Mistral AI's EU endpoint. For a path entirely in Europe, the administrator can switch to OpenRouter's EU region (Business plan).
european.unavailable: No European model is available on this server.

context.title: Context documents
context.lead: Attach a specification, a web page or a GitHub repository. The interviewer reads them to pre-fill your requirements, and the critics and the arbiter check the options against them.
context.fileTypes: PDF, Word (.docx), Markdown or text, up to {{size}} per file. For example: specification.pdf
context.urlHint: A GitHub address such as https://github.com/owner/repository imports its README, file tree, manifests and architecture notes.
context.truncated: Too long: only the beginning was kept.
context.limit: {{max}} documents at most. Remove one to add another.
context.privacy: Documents are read on this server and sent to the AI providers it uses. The models treat them as data, never as instructions.

errors.unsupported_type: This format is not supported. Use a PDF, Word (.docx), Markdown or text file, or a web address starting with http or https.
errors.too_large: This document is too large: {{size}} at most.
errors.empty: No text was found in this document.
errors.scanned: This PDF is a scan without a text layer. Run text recognition (OCR) on it first, or paste its text.
errors.encrypted: This document is protected by a password. Remove the protection and try again.
errors.fetch_failed: The page could not be fetched. Check the address, or paste its text instead.
errors.blocked_address: This address points to a private or local network, which the server does not reach.
errors.not_found: Nothing was found at this address. For a private GitHub repository, the server needs a token.
errors.rate_limited: The site is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.too_many_imports: You imported many documents in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.network: The connection was lost. Check it and try again.
errors.generic: This document could not be imported.

brief.title: Read it as
brief.hint: The same verdict, rewritten for another reader: vocabulary and detail change, never the substance.

describe.cto: A version for a CTO or lead developer: architecture, trade-offs and technical risks.
describe.executive: A version for whoever decides and pays: outcome, cost, delay, risk, and what is expected from them.
describe.client: A version for a non-technical client: what they get, when, for how much, in plain words.

matrix.hint: Move a weight and the ranking updates. An infeasible option stays last whatever its scores.
matrix.estimates: Build costs are priced from each option's work packages; running costs are the proposers' estimates.

feedback.question: Did this verdict help you?
feedback.commentLabel: What would have made it more useful? (optional)
feedback.thanks: Thank you. Your answer helps us improve the debates.
feedback.reportError: Report an error in this report
feedback.errorThanks: Thank you. We will look into it.

share.title: Share this session
share.lead: Choose what the link shows and for how long. Costs and attached documents always stay private.
share.public: Show it in the public gallery
share.publicHint: Other people can find it as an example. Only finished sessions can be listed.
share.privacy: You can stop sharing at any time: the link stops working at once.
share.readOnly: You are reading a shared session. It cannot be changed.

modeHint.client: The verdict, the options and their scores, the risks, the roadmap and the open questions, with a version written for a client. Not the debate, the interview or the requirements.
modeHint.full: The verdict, the debate, the interview and the requirements.

share.passwordSet: This link asks for a password.
share.passwordHint: Optional, at least {{min}} characters. Send it separately from the link.
share.clientReadOnly: You are reading a decision report someone shared with you.
share.notReady: The decision is not ready yet. Come back once the debate is over.
share.lockedLead: Enter the password the person who shared it gave you.

session.forkHint: A new session with the same requirements, to change what moved and run the debate again
session.deleteLead: The interview, the debate and the report are deleted for good, and any shared link stops working.
session.stopLead: The models stop at once and nothing more is spent. What is already done is kept: you can resume from where it stopped.
session.deleteBusy: Stop the session before deleting it.
session.detailsFailed: What you may do with this session could not be loaded yet, so it is shown read-only for now.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.lead: Real debates their authors chose to publish. Read how the models argued and what the arbiter decided.
gallery.empty: No public session yet. Share a finished session and choose to show it in the gallery.

settings.title: Settings
settings.loadFailed: Your saved settings could not be loaded. They cannot be changed until they are, so that nothing is overwritten.
settings.modelsLead: The models this server can use. Pick them per role when you start a session.
settings.localOnly: Local-only mode: only models running on this machine are available.
settings.retention: Sessions untouched for {{days}} days are deleted automatically.
settings.retentionNone: Sessions are kept until you delete them.
settings.deleteHint: To delete a session, open it and choose Delete.

export.markdownHint: Plain text, readable by people and coding agents
export.pdfHint: Opens the printable report: choose “Save as PDF”
export.adrHint: ADR file to commit next to the code
export.handoffHint: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and PLAN.md in a zip
export.jiraHint: The roadmap as epics and stories, for Jira's CSV import
export.linearHint: The roadmap as issues, for Linear's CSV import
export.githubHint: One issue per step and a tracking issue per phase, with a gh script
export.needsVerdict: Available once the arbiter has ruled
export.briefPdfHint: The verdict rewritten for this reader, ready to send
export.proposalWordHint: Ready to edit and send under your brand
export.proposalPdfHint: The same proposal, to save as PDF

branding.title: Branding of the exports
branding.lead: Show your agency's name, logo and color on the reports instead of Quorumind's. A discreet “Prepared with Quorumind” line remains.
branding.name: Name
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or SVG, {{size}} KB at most.
branding.logoTooLarge: This file is larger than {{size}} KB.
branding.logoType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or SVG image.
branding.accentHint: Used for headings and highlights in the exports.
branding.error: The branding could not be saved.

workspace.sharedHint: The members of your workspace can read this session.
workspace.privateHint: Only you can see this session.
workspace.readOnly: You can read this session and start again from it. Only its author or an admin of the workspace can change it.

errors.session_busy: This session is already working. Wait for it to finish.
errors.wrong_phase: This action no longer matches where the session stands. Reload the page.

errors.provider_unavailable: The model provider cannot be reached or is overloaded. Retry in a moment.
errors.provider_refused: The model declined to answer this request. Rephrase the sensitive part, or choose another model.
errors.insufficient_credits: You have no credits left. Buy credits or subscribe to a plan to continue.
errors.plan_limit: Your plan does not allow this. Choose other settings or another plan.
errors.seat_limit: This workspace has no seat left in its plan. Choose a plan with more seats.
errors.read_only: Only the author of this session or an admin of its workspace can change it.

errors.not_running: This session is not running any more.

errors.budget_fixed: The cost cap of this debate is set by the service and cannot be changed.

errors.password_required: This link asks for a password.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.questionnaire_expired: This questionnaire link has expired. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
errors.already_submitted: These answers have already been sent.

errors.not_submitted: The client has not answered yet.

errors.european_unavailable: No European model is available here. Add Mistral AI models (through OpenRouter) or local models (Ollama), or turn off European models only.
errors.no_changes: Describe the scenario in your own words, or change at least one value.
errors.no_such_revision: This version of the verdict does not exist.
errors.not_a_scenario: Only a scenario can be adopted.

errors.not_approved: This version of the decision is not approved.
errors.closed: This decision is closed. Reopen it first.
errors.audit_document_missing: Attach the document to audit: a quote, a statement of work or a proposal.

costing.title: Costing by work package
costing.ratesProfile: Priced with the day rates of your organisation profile.
costing.ratesEstimated: Day rates estimated by the proposer. Set up your organisation profile in Settings to price with your own.
costing.ratesLegacy: Build cost given as a whole by the proposer.
costing.unpriced: No day rate for {{roles}}: their days are counted, not their cost.

checks.title: Budget and deadline
checks.overRunBudget: Over the running budget by {{amount}} a month
checks.runBudgetAtRisk: May exceed the running budget by {{amount}} a month

profile.title: Organisation profile
profile.lead: What your organisation sells and can deliver. Proposals stay within it and their work packages are priced with your day rates. Each debate keeps the profile as it was when it started.
profile.name: Name
profile.euOnly: Host data and services in the EU only
profile.onPremises: On-premises hosting at the client's is acceptable
profile.rolesHint: The work packages of every proposal are priced with these rates: the totals are computed, never taken from the models.
profile.saved: Profile saved. It applies to the debates started from now on.
profile.currencyInvalid: Enter the currency as an ISO code, such as EUR.
profile.rateInvalid: Give every role a day rate above zero.
profile.managed: Your workspace's profile is managed by its owners and admins, in the workspace settings of your account.

revision.label: Revision {{number}} · {{date}}
revision.viewingOld: You are reading revision {{number}}. The current verdict is revision {{latest}}.
revision.working: Updating the recommendation with the new facts…
revision.failed: The update stopped and the verdict is unchanged. {{reason}}
revision.noChange: The new facts changed neither the recommendation, the scores, the risks nor the costs.
revision.editHint: A correction, or something you learnt since the debate. Only the arbiter rules again, not the whole debate.

client.title: Your client
client.lead: Send the open questions to your client, then update the recommendation with their answers. Your client needs no account.
client.whyLabel: Why you ask (optional, shown to your client)
client.messageHint: Shown above the questions. Without it, a short standard introduction is shown.
client.wordHint: for clients who prefer to answer by e-mail
client.applied: Revision {{number}} was made from these answers.

questionnaire.title: Questions about {{project}}
questionnaire.intro: To finalise our recommendation, we need a few answers from you. Answer what you can: “we don't know yet” is a useful answer too.
questionnaire.question: Question {{number}}
questionnaire.once: Your answers are sent once: check them before sending.
questionnaire.thanks: Thank you: your answers were sent on {{date}}.
questionnaire.thanksLead: You can close this page. If something changes, tell the person who sent you this link.
questionnaire.lockedLead: Enter the password you were given with the link.
questionnaire.missing: This questionnaire does not exist, or was withdrawn.

scenario.title: What if…
scenario.lead: Try a variant of the facts: the arbiter rules again on the same options, and the budget and deadline checks are computed with your numbers. Each scenario is kept beside the verdict, which it does not replace unless you adopt it.
scenario.name: Name of the scenario
scenario.question: What if… (in your own words)
scenario.questionHint: Optional when you change a value below.

values.team: People added, or removed with a minus sign
values.build: Change of the build budget, in percent
values.run: Change of the running budget, in percent
values.deadline: Weeks or months later, or earlier with a minus sign

scenario.working: The arbiter is ruling on the scenario…
scenario.viewing: You are reading a scenario: a variant of the facts, not the decision.
scenario.viewingAdopted: This scenario is adopted: it is the decision the team goes forward with.
scenario.adopt: Adopt this scenario as the decision

compare.title: Compare two versions
compare.none: The two versions agree on every point compared.

decision.title: Decision
decision.outdated: Revision {{number}} was approved on {{date}}; this version is not approved yet.
decision.yourName: Your name, as the register records it
decision.noOther: There is no other decision to choose from.
decision.readOnly: Only the author of this session or an admin of its workspace can approve it. You can ask them to.
decision.noteHint: One or two sentences on what was decided and why.
decision.reviewWhenPlaceholder: e.g. the price of SMS doubles
decision.reviewHint: On that date, a reminder goes to the author and to whoever approved the decision, and to the team's channel when there is one.
decision.save: Save the note and the review

register.title: Decision register
register.lead: One row per session that reached a verdict: what was decided, who approved it, and when to look at it again.
register.author: Author

audit.copied: Questions copied: paste them into your reply.
audit.copyFailed: The questions could not be copied: select them and copy them by hand.

research.title: Web research
research.intro: Checked on the web on {{date}} through {{engine}}, before the proposals. Web pages can be wrong or out of date: check those a decision hangs on.
research.running: Checking the facts the debate depends on before the proposals.
research.claimsNote: A claim is marked verified only when it cites a source found by the web research.
research.empty: The web research found nothing the debate could rely on: the facts come from the models' knowledge, which may be out of date.
research.failed: The web research failed and the debate went on without it: the facts come from the models' knowledge, which may be out of date.

skipped.european: No web research: this debate uses European models only, and no search engine keeps the queries in Europe.
skipped.unavailable: No web research: this server has no search engine configured.
skipped.budget: The web research was skipped to keep the debate within its cost cap.

research.engineDemo: the recorded results of the demo
